Hydrogenation Reaction
@graph.schema:description: RDY + 4 H2 > RDEt
@graph.schema:comment: Should I put in catalyst and solvent here as well? How do we include the solvent?

@graph.schema:name: H2 + 2 cat(H) <-> 2 cat-H
@graph.schema:description: Adsorption and desorption of hydrogen on the catalyst surface

@graph.schema:name: RDY + cat-H > cat-RYE
@graph.description: RDY reacts with one adsorbed hydrogen on the catalyst surface to form intermediate state

@graph.schema:name: cat-RYE+ cat-H > RYE + 2 cat(H)
@graph.description: cat-RYE intermediate reacts with one adsorbed hydrogen on the catalyst surface to form RYE, desorbs immediately

@graph.schema:name: RYE + cat-H > cat-RYA
@graph.description: RYE reacts with one adsorbed hydrogen on the catalyst surface to form intermediate state

@graph.schema:name: cat-RYA+ cat-H > RYA + 2 cat(H)
@graph.description: cat-RYE intermediate reacts with one adsorbed hydrogen on the catalyst surface to form RYA, desorbs immediately

@graph.schema:name: RYA + cat-H > cat-REA
@graph.description: RYA reacts with one adsorbed hydrogen on the catalyst surface to form intermediate state

@graph.schema:name: cat-REA+ cat-H > REA + 2 cat(H)
@graph.description: cat-REA intermediate reacts with one adsorbed hydrogen on the catalyst surface to form REA, desorbs immediately

@graph.schema:name: REA + cat-H > cat-RDEt
@graph.description: REA reacts with one adsorbed hydrogen on the catalyst surface to form intermediate state

@graph.schema:name: cat-RDEt+ cat-H > RDEt + 2 cat(H)
@graph.description: RDEt-cat intermediate reacts with one adsorbed hydrogen on the catalyst surface to form REA, desorbs immediately
